$schema_note: Controlled list of business functions, seeded into `document_functions`. Every filed document carries at most one function, chosen at filing, and its reference is PEL-<CODE>-<BAND><SEQ> (e.g. PEL-IT-3014) per Northern Star / ADR-0023 amendment. The function is FIXED AT FILING and is NOT a pointer to the current owner. Northern Star v6.0 FINAL uses twelve active codes: CTR + SVC replace OPS for forward filing. OPS remains in this seed as active=false so any already-issued PEL-OPS-#### rows keep a resolvable function row (R29 — never silently renumber). Derived from IMS 001 s5.3, IMS 059, Control Room / Workshop role profiles, and PEL-HSEQ-5014 v6.0 FINAL.

reference_scheme.example: PEL-IT-3014 = the 14th Procedure/Standard (L3) ever filed under IT
reference_scheme.sequence: Four digits: first digit is cascade level 1–5; remaining three are the per-(function,band) sequence, zero-padded, allocated atomically, immutable, never reused.
reference_scheme.company_prefix: PEL- is retained deliberately. Plantexpand documents are submitted into client audit packs (Thames Water, UKPN, Cadent, SGN); a bare IT3014 could not be asserted as Plantexpand's within a client bundle.
reference_scheme.supersedes: PEL-<FUNCTION>-0### (WA-2 unbanded) and PEL-<SECTION>-<SUB>-<SEQ> (taxonomy v1). Issued references stay verbatim; they cannot collide with banded form because banded sequences always start 1–5 and unbanded WA-2 always start with 0.

test_for_a_function: A function earns a code only if it has a distinct accountable owner AND a filer could reliably pick it without judgement. Where two candidates share an owner or produce documents that straddle the boundary, they are merged - an ambiguous code is worse than a coarse one, because the reference is immutable and a mis-filed one cannot be corrected in place.

functions.name: Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
functions.description: The integrated management system and the entire assessment estate under one accountable owner: risk assessments, COSHH assessments, method statements and safe systems of work; policies, procedures, registers, objectives, internal and external audit, non-conformance; ISO 9001/14001/45001 evidence; environment and sustainability including carbon reporting, Planet Mark, waste and the aspects register. Merged from the former HS and CMP codes: IMS 001 s5.3 places quality, environment and health & safety under a single Compliance Manager, so splitting them produced two codes with one owner.

functions.name: IT & Information Security
functions.description: ISMS documentation, information security policies, secure development, third-party supplier security, security incident reporting. IMS 001 s5.3 records IT support as outsourced to Salbourne while IMS 059 names an internal IT Manager; the function is owned internally regardless of who delivers it.

functions.name: Facilities & Premises
functions.description: The Wickford units and other fixed premises: site risk assessments, buildings compliance, fire, electrical, water hygiene, asbestos, pedestrian and vehicle segregation on site. Kept separate from Operations because the owner differs and the regulatory regime is a landlord/occupier one, not a service-delivery one.

functions.name: People
functions.description: Employment and competence together: recruitment, onboarding and inductions, the employee handbook, absence, equal opportunities, right to work, harassment, training records, certificates and eLearning. Merged from the former HR and TRN codes because five documents straddled the boundary and were filed inconsistently - the Staff Induction Policy to Training, Right to Work to HR, the Training Costs Agreement (an employment agreement) to Training.

functions.name: Procurement & Supply Chain
functions.description: Approved suppliers and subcontractors, supplier codes of conduct, modern slavery assurance, subcontractor RAMS and insurances, supplier assessments and PQQs. Distinct owner and its own external obligation under the Modern Slavery Act.

functions.name: Fleet & Transport
functions.description: Plantexpand as a vehicle operator and employer of drivers: vehicle records, MOT and tax status, walkaround and defect reports, DVLA licence checks, drivers' hours, grey fleet. Deliberately NOT the workshop — see SVC.

functions.name: Control Room
functions.description: Control Room planning, processing, scheduling, call-ahead and resource optimisation. Split from the former OPS fold by Northern Star v6.0 FINAL so Control Room has a distinct accountable owner (Control Room Manager) and a filer can pick it without judgement. BOUNDARY: workshop / mobile engineering delivery is SVC; vehicle operator compliance is FLT.

functions.name: Service Delivery (workshop and mobile engineering)
functions.description: Delivery of the service the business sells in the workshop and via mobile engineering: plant maintenance records, asset register, calibration, pre-use checks, business continuity for service delivery. Split from the former OPS fold by Northern Star v6.0 FINAL under the Workshop Manager. BOUNDARY: Control Room scheduling is CTR; technical specifications are TECH; fleet/driver compliance is FLT.

functions.name: Technical
functions.description: Technical authority for the service the business delivers: torque and tightening standards, service and repair schedules, manufacturer technical data and service bulletins, diagnostic procedures, equipment manuals and specifications, and the technical standards engineers must work to. BOUNDARY: distinct from IT (systems / information security). Distinct from SVC (workshop / mobile delivery records) and CTR (control-room scheduling): a PPM schedule record is SVC, the specification that schedule implements is TECH. Distinct from HSEQ (hazard control): how to weld safely is HSEQ, the weld specification is TECH.

functions.name: Data Protection
functions.description: UK GDPR accountability: data protection policy, ROPA, DPIAs, data subject access requests, personal-data breach handling. Kept separate from IT despite low volume because the DPO is expected to be independent of the function that runs the systems.

functions.name: Finance
functions.description: Insurance certificates, utility bills and energy data, and cost information feeding governance reporting. No documents in the current estate; seeded so the first one filed gets the right reference rather than a borrowed and immutable wrong one.

functions.name: Commercial
functions.description: Client-facing commercial activity: account management and client-specific operating arrangements. Customer contracts themselves are out of scope for the library (decision of 8 Aug 2026); the code exists so client-facing operational documents are not forced into Operations.

functions.name: Operations (withdrawn — use CTR or SVC)
functions.description: WITHDRAWN from the Northern Star vocabulary (ADR-0023 § Amendment / Wave W2). Retained inactive so any already-issued PEL-OPS-#### references remain resolvable (R29). Forward filing must use CTR (Control Room) or SVC (Service Delivery / workshop).
